text.name: rm_fm_settings_availability_tooltip
text.text: Controls how many fields are available for purchase. Higher difficulty means fewer fields and longer waits. Fields rotate based on a seasonal market (more listings Nov-Mar). 'Realistic' is extreme - most fields stay locked for months.

text.name: rm_fm_settings_pricePerHa_tooltip
text.text: Set a custom base price per hectare for all farmland. Crop value is added on top.

text.name: rm_fm_settings_pricePerHa_dialogPrompt
text.text: Enter base price per hectare (map default: %s/ha)

text.name: rm_fm_settings_negotiateBuy_tooltip
text.text: When buying a listed field, negotiate the price through offers and counter-offers instead of paying the list price instantly.

text.name: rm_fm_settings_negotiateSell_tooltip
text.text: When selling your field, an NPC buyer negotiates through offers and counter-offers instead of an instant sale at market value.

text.name: rm_fm_settings_unlistedOffers_tooltip
text.text: Allow making offers on fields that are not listed for sale. The owner may refuse or demand a premium. Requires Field Availability to be enabled.
